text: 中国证监会国际合作司发布关于维达力科技股份有限公司境外发行上市及境内未上市股份“全流通”备案通知书，公司拟发行不超过220,164,400股境外上市普通股并在香港联合交易所上市。公司17名股东拟将所持合计765,789,470股境内未上市股份转为境外上市股份，并在香港联合交易所上市流通。
text_en: The International Cooperation Department of the China Securities Regulatory Commission issued a filing notice regarding VDL Technology Co., Ltd.'s overseas issuance and listing and "full circulation" of domestic unlisted shares. The company plans to issue no more than 220,164,400 overseas listed ordinary shares and list them on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The company's 17 shareholders plan to convert a total of 765,789,470 domestic unlisted shares into overseas listed shares for circulation on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
